title: World Wellbeing Kitchen — India regional recipe development map
editorial_scope: 300 individually authored vegetarian and vegan recipes representing all 28 Indian states and 8 union territories, with additional city and regional collections for Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Delhi and other food centres.
dietary_rules: Clearly label dairy-containing vegetarian recipes and fully vegan recipes
Offer practical substitutions and check packaged ingredients for hidden allergens
allocation_policy: Build a balanced national collection rather than assigning identical quotas mechanically. Ensure every state and union territory has multiple authentic regional recipes; allocate more entries to regions with broader vegetarian culinary traditions and strong dish diversity. Do not claim a dish is traditionally vegan if the traditional version contains dairy or ghee; label the adapted version clearly.
recipe_requirements: One standalone JSON file per recipe
Specific regional origin and state or union territory
Dish-specific photograph with cleared usage rights and attribution
Microwave, conventional oven and air-fryer adaptations where suitable; state when a method is unsuitable
Vegetarian or vegan label; egg-free and nut-free checks
Estimated nutrition with calculation basis and uncertainty
Source references for traditional context and method, plus notes identifying adaptations
